test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

We / has seen / that movie / before.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. has seen has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**has**" is incorrect when used with the subject "**We**," which is plural.
 
• The correct verb form to use with "**We**" is "**have**."
 
• The correct form of the sentence should be *"We **have **seen that movie before."*
 
• Using "**has**" with "**We" **breaks the subject-verb agreement rule in English grammar.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *We have seen that movie before*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: before** - This is a preposition indicating a point in time, and it is correctly used here.
 
• **Option 3: that movie** - This phrase correctly identifies the object of the verb "seen."
 
• **Option 4: We** - This is the subject of the sentence and is correctly used.
